batch: Classify five works after authoritative bibliographic repair
policy: These are work-scope judgments only. They do not certify complete object extraction, endorse readings, resolve identities, or change text and media rights.

entries.basis: Peeters' abstract for DOI 10.2143/MUS.120.1.2020266 says the article presents a new edition, translation and philological notes for BM 91767.
Peeters' abstract for DOI 10.2143/ARAM.11.2.504467 describes an overview of Mandaic script and published lead rolls and bowls, together with first publication of one Miami University Museum bowl.
Tel Aviv University's abstract for DOI 10.1177/147783510400200204 describes a new transcription, translation and interpretation of BM 135563.

The University of Exeter repository description says the thesis supplies first editions of twenty-five Berlin bowls, with transcription, translation, philological notes, drawings, commentary and glossaries.
The MDPI abstract frames a study of the Schoyen Collection, antiquities trafficking, collectors, scholars, institutions, provenance and research ethics.
